plan.failureSummary: Page.AI deterministic cache replay failed to find the 'Last Name *' input field because the survey form fields have changed on the live page.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred directly inside cached replay code at tests/.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js:38:9
Heuristics indicate failureInCacheReplay is true and isRetryAttempt is false
Cached step looked for selectors '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' and 'Last Name *', which do not exist on the current page
Failure screenshot shows the form now has fields 'Your Name *', 'Contact Email *', and 'Occupation *' instead of the cached fields
Overall objective is semantically flexible ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...'), making autonomous regeneration highly likely to succeed

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache file for unstable-survey.test.ts and re-run the standalone project to regenerate the actions against the updated form layout.

plan.notes: The test executed in DETERMINISTIC mode using cached Page.AI instructions that expected a 'Last Name *' field. The failure screenshot confirms the live page now presents a different form structure ('Your Name *', 'Contact Email *', 'Occupation *'). Because the Page.AI instruction is generic ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...'), clearing the cache and retrying autonomously will allow Page.AI to adapt to the new form layout.
